instruction: You should walk past the bar and to the pool. Across from the pool there is a doorway, go through that doorway and wait.

steps.thought: I see a spa/pool area with lounge chairs and a pool on the right. I need to locate the bar first, then the pool, then a doorway across from it. Let me survey the room by turning right.
I can see the pool ahead with a lit doorway on the far right wall across from it. I'll advance toward the pool, steering slightly right of the chair to keep the doorway in view.
I can see the pool ahead with a lit doorway-like opening on the far right wall across the pool. I'll advance toward the pool area, keeping the armchair on my left, then head toward that doorway.
I've reached the pool area; the lit doorway appears on the far wall to the right of the pool. I'll advance past the chair toward the pool, then re-aim toward that doorway.
I'm at the pool area now, with the pool ahead and a lit doorway visible on the right side of the far wall. I'll advance toward the pool, then turn right to approach that doorway across from the pool.
I'm at the pool and can see a wooden doorway across the pool on the right side of the view. I'll turn right to face it, then approach it.
I'm at the pool area and can see a lit doorway across the room, roughly straight ahead. I'll advance toward it, re-checking alignment as I go.
I'm at the pool, and the lit doorway across from it is visible ahead, roughly centered. I'll advance toward it a couple of steps and re-check alignment before entering.
The pool is on my left and the doorway across from it is visible ahead, roughly centered. I'll move forward toward it, then re-check alignment before passing through.
The pool is on my left and the doorway across from it is visible ahead. I need to close the distance to the doorway, checking alignment as I go.
The pool is on my left and the wooden doorway across from it is directly ahead, slightly left of center. I'll move forward toward it and re-observe before entering.
I'm at the pool area; the wooden doorway across from the pool is visible ahead. I'll advance toward it, re-checking alignment before entering.
I am beside the pool, and the wooden doorway across from it is directly ahead. I will advance toward it, re-checking alignment before entering.
I am at the pool facing the doorway with the beaded curtain directly across from it. I need to advance toward and through that doorway, then stop just past it.
I'm at the pool facing the doorway across from it, which is centered in my view. I'll advance through the doorway and then stop just past it.
I have reached the doorway across from the pool; the beaded curtain is directly ahead and centered. I will step through it and then stop to wait.
